name: TradeIQ FINAL Local Workflow - Import This

parameters.content:
FINAL LOCAL TRADEIQ WORKFLOW

Before running:
1. Start python webhook_server.py
2. Start n8n with N8N_BLOCK_OUTGOING_IPS_BY_DEFAULT=false
3. Run from Manual Start

Use only this workflow for local execution.

nodes.name: Manual Start
nodes.notes: Click Execute Workflow in n8n to run one full cycle immediately.

nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs automatically every 5 minutes when the workflow is active.

nodes.name: Bridge Health Check
nodes.notes: Checks that python webhook_server.py is running on 127.0.0.1:8502.

nodes.name: Fetch Market Data
nodes.notes: Fetches latest OHLCV through Python/yfinance and saves to trading.db for Streamlit.

nodes.name: Run Sentiment
nodes.notes: Runs full Python sentiment analysis and saves headline scores to trading.db.

nodes.name: Run ML Predictions
nodes.notes: Runs the Python ensemble ML pipeline and saves BUY/SELL/HOLD signals.

nodes.name: Load Latest Signals
nodes.notes: Loads latest saved ML signals from the ml_predictions table.

nodes.name: Route Signals
nodes.notes: Groups signals for report, notification, and trading decisions.

nodes.name: Execute Paper Trades
nodes.notes: Runs BUY/SELL paper-trading agents with risk controls. LIVE_MODE remains controlled by .env.

nodes.name: Portfolio Status
nodes.notes: Reads cash, starting balance, open positions, unrealised P&L, and recent trades.

nodes.name: Build Cycle Report
nodes.notes: Final report used by n8n execution output, Telegram, and Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Build Telegram Message
nodes.notes: Optional Telegram report formatter. The send node is disabled until credentials are set.

nodes.name: Telegram Alert
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable after adding Telegram credentials and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

nodes.name: Build Sheets Row
nodes.notes: Optional Google Sheets row formatter. The append node is disabled until credentials are set.

nodes.name: Google Sheets Log
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable after adding Google credentials and GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.
